news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path ko Milega Vishwashtariya Swaroop
bullets: Bihar Govt ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena shuru kiya, jisme 65 kilometer Ganga Channel ka vikas hoga
Is project ke liye koi vishisht budget outlay nahi di gayi, lekin yeh Bihar ke vikas mein ek mahatvapurn kadam hai
Yeh project Bihar ke Saat Nischay-2 yojana ke tahat aata hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ke infrastructure ko badhava dena hai

news_cards.title: Bihar State Cooperative Bank ki Karyapranali ko Badhava
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar State Cooperative Bank ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi, aadhunik aur janonmukhi banane ke nirdesh diye
Bank ki karyapranali mein sudhar ke liye koi vishisht yojana nahi di gayi, lekin yeh bank ke vikas mein ek mahatvapurn kadam hai
Yeh kadam Bihar ke arthik vikas ke liye avashyak hai, kyunki cooperative bank rajya ke gramin kshetron mein arthik suvidhaon ka pradaan karta hai

news_cards.title: Gaya me 6000 Cr ki Steel Plant ke Liye MoU
bullets: Bihar Govt ne Gaya me 6000 Cr ki Steel Plant ke liye MoU sign kiya, jiska uddeshya rajya mein udyogik vikas ko badhava dena hai
Is project ke liye 6000 Cr ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, aur yeh project 2027 tak poora hona hai
Yeh project Bihar ke udyogik vikas ke liye ek mahatvapurn kadam hai, kyunki yeh rajya mein rozgar ke avsar paida karega

news_cards.title: RERA ki Karyapranali ko Badhava
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne RERA ki karyapranali ko pardarshi, saral aur digital banane ke nirdesh diye
RERA ki karyapranali mein sudhar ke liye koi vishisht yojana nahi di gayi, lekin yeh gharelu kharidaron ke hiton ko surakshit karega
Yeh kadam Bihar ke gharelu kharidaron ke liye avashyak hai, kyunki yeh unke hiton ko surakshit karega

news_cards.title: Patna Metro ke Liye Nehrui Path par Sugam Yatayat
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Patna Metro ke liye Nehrui Path par sugam yatayat ko surakshit banana shuru kiya
Is project ke liye koi vishisht budget outlay nahi di gayi, lekin yeh Patna ke vikas mein ek mahatvapurn kadam hai
Yeh project Bihar ke vikas ke liye avashyak hai, kyunki yeh Patna ke logon ke liye sugam yatayat ko surakshit karega
